svg.aria-label: Demo: an agent breaks add() and edits the test until it passes; pocp verify runs the old test on the new code and holds the change for a maintainer; the agent puts the test back and fixes add(), and verify passes
svg.title: POCP demo: an agent edits a test to pass; POCP holds it until the code is fixed

g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
g.text: # An agent rewrites add() and breaks it for negative numbers.
✗ 1 test failed: 2 !== 0
# The test fails. So the agent edits the test until it passes:
- assert.equal(add(-1, 1), 0);
+ assert.equal(add(-1, 1), 2);
✓ 1 test passed
# Plain CI runs the current tests on the current code: green.
# POCP blocks the commit until the change has evidence. The agent runs pocp fix:
pocp fix: committable now; CI requires human approval of the test change
# In CI, POCP re-runs the checks, and runs the OLD test on the NEW code:
NOT verified: 1 commit(s) in main..HEAD · 1309ms
rerun passed npm test --silent <- the edited test passes
BAD: the old tests fail on the new code ("npm test --silent" exit 1)
behavior changed, so a person must approve it
[maintainer] next: a maintainer reviews the test change
and adds the `pocp-approve-tests` label
# Exit code 1: in block mode, only a maintainer can accept this test edit.
# So the agent puts the test back and fixes add() instead:
-export const add = (a, b) => Math.abs(a) + b;
+export const add = (a, b) => a + b;
- assert.equal(add(-1, 1), 2);
+ assert.equal(add(-1, 1), 0);
✓ 1 test passed
# CI verifies the whole pull request again:
verified: 2 commit(s) in main..HEAD · 1236ms
rerun passed npm test --silent <- the original test, on the fixed code
# Exit code 0: verified, ready to merge: the bug is fixed and the test is the original.
